title: Scaling Public Health Text Annotation: Zero-Shot Learning vs. Crowdsourcing for Improved Efficiency and Labeling Accuracy

live_model.evidence: labeling via the GPT-4 Turbo API (Introduction); 'GPT-4 Turbo charges $0.01 for each 1,000 input tokens and $0.03 for each 1,000 output tokens' (Results)

prompt.note: Final per-category prompts were refined by the model itself and applied to batches of 800-1000 tweets; they are not printed.

claim.metric: labeling accuracy vs expert gold labels (all categories)
claim.location: Table I, row Total, column GPT Accuracy

data.source: 12,000 Canadian tweets rehydrated by ID from a public-health crowdsourcing repository [11]; expert and AMT labels

notes: Tweets must be rehydrated through the X API (paid, deleted posts lost); labels came from majority vote of three runs; February 2025 arXiv with no preview string.
